lua.description: Lua 5.4 scripting language for the SwirlOS terminal.
lua.author: Swirl
lua.title: Lua
lua.tagline: Run Lua scripts from the terminal.
lua.long:
Lua 5.4.9, the small fast scripting language.
Type: lua -run /home/user/hello.lua
Or straight from the prompt: lua -e print(1+1)
Relative paths work from the folder you are in. Docs: cat /system/doc/lua.txt
